title: alnus spachii
intro: Alnus spachii, commonly known as Spach's alder, is a species of tree in the family Betulaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Alnus spachii include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Alnus spachii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
